caption:
You built one follow-up habit. Leads use four different doors to reach you.

Phone, web form, DM or Google message, and walk-in or referral. Most shops built a fast response for the first door and left the other three on manual.

This week, list every way a lead can reach your business. For each one, ask: does it trigger a response in minutes, or does it wait for someone to notice?

A channel without an automatic response bleeds leads.

See every channel land in one inbox with automatic response built in.
